cases.name: fresh_install_asks_to_notify
cases.detail: asked, was allowed, and DELIVERED. From POST_NOTIFICATIONS revoked (granted=false), its user-set/user-fixed flags cleared and notify-kit's permission_requested flag cleared — a never-asked state established entirely from outside the app — a cold launch through the dev-client entry URL with no deep link and no debug screen put the system prompt on screen within 180s. After Allow the OS reads granted=true and the app reads '[harness] result: notification_status=authorized notifications_granted=true exact_alarm_granted=true'. A reminder seeded through the production scheduler (armed=32 for 1786115520000) then POSTED — not merely armed.
